description: 250 Watt Solar Panel with Portable Iron Wheel Stand, 12V Lithium Battery, Controller Charger, 200W Converter - Distributed/Packaged by Generic. Product Details: This portable solar power system is a robust and self-contained unit designed to harness solar energy with ease and efficiency. Mounted on a sturdy wheeled cart, the system offers excellent mobility, allowing you to position it wherever sunlight is most abundant. The large solar panel is securely elevated on a metal frame, maximising sun exposure throughout the day. Beneath the panel, the cart houses a charge controller and a battery unit, all neatly integrated for a compact and organised setup. The wheeled base makes transportation effortless, whether across a worksite, garden, or outdoor event space. Ideal for off-grid applications, remote locations, camping, or as a backup power source, this system provides a reliable and convenient way to generate and store electricity. The charge controller ensures safe and efficient charging of the battery, protecting it from overcharging. This all-in-one solar trolley system is a practical solution for anyone seeking an independent and portable power supply.
